question_text: What is new about 10 Hz Combine tracking?
claim: Tracked top speed (p95) of the forty is highly repeatable between attempts
value: ICC 0.95 [0.94, 0.96]; atlas grade Strong
limitation: one drill, 10 Hz, eligible recordings only

claim: Speed development (time from 4 to 8 yd/s) is repeatable and only partly explained by the stopwatch
value: ICC 0.82 [0.78, 0.86]; R² on the stopwatch 0.65; atlas grade Provisional
limitation: acquisition dependence uncertain; needs the 4 → 8 yd/s interval to be recorded

claim: Peak tangential acceleration is NOT repeatable enough to describe an athlete
value: ICC 0.35 [0.20, 0.49]; atlas grade Reject / not currently usable
limitation: single-frame extremes of a 10 Hz derivative

question_text: Which features are already explained by official testing?
claim: Tracked top speed is largely the same information as official testing
value: R² on the stopwatch 0.87
limitation: within position

claim: The speed-by-distance curve of a forty is low-dimensional
value: two components explain 97.7 % of held-out curve variance (mean over 15 fold fits)
limitation: statistical axes, not physical quantities

claim: TCN-B recognises an athlete's repeat attempt: a repeatable movement fingerprint
value: repeat-attempt retrieval AUC 0.873 [0.856, 0.890]
limitation: a similarity space; no dimension has a physical meaning

claim: The fingerprint still recognises the athlete among prospects with near-identical official results
value: matched-stopwatch retrieval AUC 0.796 [0.768, 0.824]
limitation: repeatable is not predictive

question_text: Why did the first NFL prediction attempt fail to establish added value?
claim: TCN-B did NOT establish an improvement of held-out NFL sustained-acceleration prediction beyond official testing
value: Δ RMSE +0.0003 [-0.0008, +0.0015] (+0.16 % of the official-model error); interval includes 0
limitation: 284 athletes; small effects are not detectable (C10); frozen conclusion of Milestone 06

value: athlete share of within-position NFL window variance 6.3 % [5.0, 7.2]
limitation: observed context labels only
